references.text: The same ritual is described for a person of ordinary means—the priest pours oil into his left hand as part of the cleansing ceremony.
The introduction to the cleansing ritual mentions the oil (log of oil) to be used in the ceremony described in verse 26.
The continuation of the ritual where the priest uses the oil from his left hand to sprinkle and anoint the one being cleansed.
Anointing oil is poured over Aaron's head during his consecration as a priest, illustrating the role of oil in holy ceremonies.
Moses pours anointing oil on Aaron's head, illustrating the priest's role in administering holy oil.
